# Lanesra OS

Lanesra OS is a modern, open-source sales and business management application for small businesses.

## Current status

- Early Access v0.27.0
- App Builder: an Administrator can group any set of objects - Custom Objects or built-ins - their published Screen/App Builder layouts, and one dashboard into a named, publishable app with its own icon, then grant it to specific roles or individual users as Viewer or Editor. Every published app filters navigation and adds an entry to a sidebar App Switcher. Access is enforced server-side on the desktop edition: once an object type is placed in a published app, creating, editing or archiving a record of that type (including status-lifecycle actions like issuing/voiding an invoice or converting a quote to an order) requires at least Editor access to some app containing it - objects never placed in an app are unaffected. The desktop UI also disables the relevant buttons for a Viewer before a click ever reaches the server. Shipped on desktop first and mirrored in the online demo (Admin → Apps, the sidebar App Switcher, and an app-scoped dashboard).
- Browser-based live demo is available, including a working Admin panel with admin-defined Custom Objects (define a whole new business object at runtime - Vendors, Assets, Projects - which becomes a full citizen of custom fields, business rules, status transitions and workflow automation, exactly like a built-in entity), admin-defined Custom Relationships (connect any two object types - built-in or custom - with a cardinality, forward/reverse labels and a delete behavior; every record's edit form shows a "Related records" panel with inline link/unlink), a Reports section (the desktop edition's full fixed report gallery - Revenue by month, Win rate by owner, Lost reasons, AR aging, Sales by owner - plus a Custom Reports builder that groups any built-in or custom object by its status/stage or a reportable custom field, count or sum, with CSV export on every report), a no-code Screen layouts designer (drag-order any built-in or custom object's create/edit fields into named sections, with a Draft → Preview → Publish flow so a layout change never touches the live form until published), an Integrations admin section (schedule data Export/Import/Sync jobs with a Run now simulation and per-job history, define and "expose" API endpoints with a Test call returning real demo data as JSON, and configure external API connections with a Test request and call history - all a UI-only simulation, since the static demo has no server to make a real network call), a Status Transition Editor, workflow actions to create a new record (any of the 9 built-in entities) or update a related record (walking the relationship graph in both directions, not just downward), a Test rule / Test workflow dry-run mode, a redesigned rule-builder layout with a visual trigger → action canvas for workflows, custom field extensibility (default values, uniqueness, placeholder/help text, required, max length/pattern, min/max, and searchable/filterable/reportable flags), and Customer 360 / Contact 360 detail pages for every company and contact
- Windows desktop edition is in early development: the source is public today (Tauri + Rust + SQLite) with the full sales lifecycle, Contracts, Tasks, user management, Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker), backup/restore, self-service password change, PDF generation and printing, and CSV import/export all working. desktop-v0.11.0 is the latest tagged Early Access Windows installer (.exe/.msi) on GitHub Releases (unsigned); build and run from source is also supported.
- Also shipped: an Admin panel giving admins broad control without code changes - user & role management, an editable business profile (name, phone, address, logo), branding and print customization, reports beyond the dashboard plus a simple custom report builder (group by any field including custom fields, count or sum), custom fields on every major object with optional validation (min/max, max length, regex) and capability flags, conditional business rules (multi-condition AND/OR, 10 operators, require/hide/lock/set-value/block-save/show-message actions), richer workflow automation (triggers on status/field changes and dates, actions to create a task, assign the owner, create a related record, or post an in-app notification), admin-defined Custom Objects (entirely new record types with no code), custom relationships between any two record types with cardinality and delete-behavior rules, admin-configurable ID/numbering formats per object, a dashboard KPI picker, Windows task reminder notifications, and a session inactivity auto-lock.
- The online demo now covers every capability identified in this round of parity work - Custom Objects, Custom Relationships, Reports, Screen layouts and Integrations - closing the gap with the desktop edition and adding two capabilities (Screen layouts, Integrations) that don't exist on desktop either.
- Admin no longer opens into a flat tab row on either the demo or the desktop app: a categorized landing page (Workspace, Access, Customization, Automation, Integrations) routes straight into each builder, with a breadcrumb back. Business Rules and Workflow Automation both gained Duplicate (clone as an inactive draft), a bounded version history with one-click Restore, and a dependency warning before deactivating a custom field an active rule or workflow still relies on.
- Windows desktop edition only: a topbar Global search box resolves matches across every core entity, active custom objects, and any custom field flagged Searchable, jumping straight to the record; every list screen also gained filter controls for Filterable-flagged custom fields. First real use of the is_searchable/is_filterable capability flags introduced back in the custom field extensibility round.
- Team Workspace server: can now be exposed on the open internet on an organization's own domain (still self-hosted, never a Lanesra-run SaaS) - an opt-in env var marks the session cookie Secure and sends Strict-Transport-Security once a reverse proxy is actually terminating TLS in front of it, an opt-in CORS allowlist for the rare case the frontend is served from a different origin than the API, and always-on security response headers. The README documents minimal Caddy and nginx reverse-proxy recipes. Off by default, so the original LAN-only plain-HTTP behavior is unchanged unless explicitly opted into.

## Core capabilities

- Companies and contacts
- Opportunities and sales pipeline
- Products and services
- Quotes, orders and invoices
- Contracts
- Tasks and activities
- Sales dashboards with an admin-configurable KPI selection
- Connected relationship validation, plus admin-defined custom relationships between any record types
- Admin-defined Custom Objects - entirely new record types with their own fields, numbering and screens
- Admin-configurable record numbering (custom prefix and digit width per object)
- Admin panel: users & roles, business profile, custom fields (with validation), business rules (multi-condition, 10 operators), workflow automation (more triggers/actions, in-app notifications), relationships, numbering, dashboard KPIs
- App Builder: package objects, screens and a dashboard into a named, publishable app with role/user-based Viewer/Editor access, enforced server-side on every write

## Product principles

- User ownership of business data
- Offline-first desktop direction
- Connected records instead of duplicated free text
- Simplicity before feature volume
- Open-source transparency
- Modern, accessible product design
